setup.scope: This market covers wireless earbuds — true wireless stereo (TWS) earbuds and wireless earphones that connect to a source device via Bluetooth or other wireless protocols, including in-ear, open-ear, and on-ear wireless bud form factors sold as consumer audio devices. It excludes wired earphones/headphones, over-ear wireless headphones, wired headsets, and hearing aids, which are separately valued markets. It also excludes the smartphone, charging case, and accessory aftermarket as standalone markets, though smartphone installed-base and replacement-cycle data may be used as intermediate signals to derive earbud demand. Demand is measured at the point of consumer purchase (retail sell-through/shipments to end users), not at component or OEM contract-manufacturing level.

setup.scope: This market covers True Wireless Stereo (TWS) earbuds: standalone, cable-free earbud pairs that connect to source devices via Bluetooth for personal audio playback and communication. Included are all consumer and professional TWS earbud products sold as finished goods, whether standard, mini, premium, or feature-differentiated (e.g., ANC, spatial audio), and their associated replacement units. Excluded are wired earphones, over-ear and on-ear wireless headphones, bone-conduction headsets, hearing aids, and component-level sales of drivers, chipsets, or batteries that are not part of a finished earbud pair. Also excluded are separately valued services such as music streaming subscriptions, even though streaming demand may be used as an intermediate signal of earbud usage intensity.
